faq.title: XKR SV8TS FAQs
faq.description: Answers about pricing, warranty, engine codes and fitting for the supercharged Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine replacement?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your SV8TS engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply includes a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.
Catalogues list the XKR's SV8TS at 306kW, shown as 416hp, with a 313kW variant also listed. We confirm your exact output from the VIN before supplying a replacement.

faqs.q: Was the SV8TS fitted to the 2006 XKR?
faqs.a: Yes. Catalogues list the supercharged 4.2 XKR from 2006, and it remained until the 5.0 508PS replaced it in 2009. We still verify your engine code first.

faqs.q: How does SV8TS relate to the AJ8FT code?
faqs.a: Different catalogues use different codes for the supercharged 4.2 V8 family. SV8TS and AJ8FT can both appear in listings, so we match by VIN rather than code alone.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include supercharger coupling rattle, timing chain tensioner wear, cracked coolant pipes, intercooler pump faults and coil failures. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: What does your SV8TS supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete any setup and road test your XKR. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Before Committing to a Replacement SV8TS Engine
workshopIntro.description: Diagnose first, then decide. Cracked coolant pipes, coil packs and supercharger couplings can often be replaced without removing the engine. If overheating or chain failure has caused internal damage, weigh the repair estimate against your XKR's mileage, condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether fitting is included. Installing a supercharged V8 in an XKR involves considerable labour, so complete supply and fit quotes provide the clearest comparison between suppliers.

When reviewing SV8TS 4.2 V8 supercharged petrol engine UK listings, ask whether the unit came from an XKR or an XF. Ancillaries can differ, so confirm the donor model, recorded mileage and any pre-sale checks.

Warranty deserves a look as well. A Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain any conditions before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XKR SV8TS Engine Problems Worth Checking
engineProblems.description: Each symptom may indicate a fault; only diagnosis can confirm it properly.

cards.title: Supercharger Coupling Rattle
cards.description: A rattle at idle that disappears as revs rise could indicate a worn coupling between the supercharger and its drive.

cards.title: Noise From Timing Chains
cards.description: A brief rattle on cold starts might suggest timing chain tensioners or guides are wearing on one or both banks.
cards.action: Book a timing inspection before it worsens.

cards.title: Cracked Coolant Pipes
cards.description: Coolant loss or a sweet smell may point to cracked plastic coolant pipes, a water pump or the thermostat housing.
cards.action: Request a cooling pressure test today.

cards.title: Heat-Soaked Performance
cards.description: Power dropping noticeably on hot days or after hard use could relate to the intercooler pump or its circuit.

cards.title: Coil Pack Misfires
cards.description: A flashing engine light, shaking or hesitation under load may be caused by failing coil packs or worn plugs.
cards.action: Get the ignition system tested promptly.

cards.title: Visible Oil Seepage
cards.description: Oil on the cam covers or under the car may indicate tired gaskets or seals around the supercharged V8.
cards.action: Have the leak traced and assessed.

engineOverview.title: How the SV8TS Powered the Early X150 XKR
paragraphs: SV8TS is a catalogue code for Jaguar's 4,196cc supercharged V8, fitted to the X150 XKR coupé and convertible before the 5.0 arrived. Parts listings rate it at 306kW, with a 313kW variant also shown. The same code appears for the supercharged XF of that period.

That 306kW rating is listed as 416hp, which is why buyers search for a Jaguar XKR 4.2 V8 supercharged petrol engine 416hp. The engine drives the rear wheels and uses chain-driven camshafts throughout, so routine cambelt servicing is never involved.

A Jaguar XKR SV8TS engine 2006 is a genuine fit, as catalogues list the supercharged 4.2 XKR from that year. It remained until 2009, when the 508PS 5.0 replaced it, so we confirm generation and code using your car's VIN.
